_meta.purpose: SSOT for the CCATO Tier-1 narrative-truth gate. scripts/narrative-truth-gate.sh reads ALL negation lexicon + dimension->tool routing + argument-shape + no-data-response markers from THIS file at runtime. ZERO hardcode of lexicon/tools/tickers in the shell script.
_meta.extension_notes: Brief S4.2 defines negation_lexicon + dimensions[].{id,keywords,tool,requires_ticker}. This file additively extends each dimension with `arg_style` (how the .sh must shape the MCP tool-call arguments object for that tool's REAL input schema, gateway-verified 2026-07-01) and adds a top-level `tool_null_markers` array (substrings that classify a LIVE tool response as an honest no-data / honest-NULL answer, vs a populated answer). Both extensions are pure SSOT data — the script contains no dimension/tool/lexicon literals, only generic dispatch on these field values.
_meta.requires_ticker_semantics: requires_ticker governs the CLAIM-side identifier reported in the narrative_contradiction signal's ticker_or_dim field (a specific ticker vs the dimension id). It does NOT mean the tool call itself is ticker-less — some tools (get_foreign_flow) still require a `code` argument even when requires_ticker=false at the claim level; for those, the script resolves a probe ticker via the first ticker mentioned anywhere in the post body (VN-ticker regex + non_ticker_tokens denylist, same extraction used for requires_ticker=true dimensions), never a hardcoded ticker.

arg_style_values.ticker_actionCode_yoy: arguments = { actionCode: <ticker>, period1: <latest fully-elapsed quarter, computed at runtime>, period2: <same quarter prior year> }

_meta.non_ticker_tokens_rationale: VN-ticker extraction regex is [A-Z]{2,4} per brief S4.3 step 3. A bare regex over-matches common finance/report abbreviations (RSI, USD, GDP, VN, AI, ...). non_ticker_tokens is the exclusion denylist the script filters candidates through — same category of structural noise-token list already established as legitimate inline data in scripts/fb-data-integrity-gate.sh's NON_TICKERS set; kept here (not inline in the .sh) so the ticker-extraction denylist is also runtime-SSOT-driven, not a script literal.
_meta.deviations_from_brief: market_snapshot.keywords deviates from the brief S4.2 literal example (which lists bare "giá" and "phiên"). RAW-tested against docs/social/fb-post-2026-06-30.md: both bare tokens collide with the ubiquitous VN finance phrase "phiên này" (= "this session"), which co-occurs with the VNM TA-absence sentence AND the foreign-flow-absence sentence — causing 2 phantom market_snapshot FAILs alongside the 2 intended contradictions. Tightened to compound phrases ("khối lượng giao dịch", "giá đóng cửa", "độ rộng thị trường") that do not appear in either DoD sentence, restoring precision to exactly the 2 documented CCATO instances. Verified via live re-probe run 2026-07-01.
